obligation: G032 -- which half of the fold carries the win, and what does each cost to implement
t_fold: diag(1/t) into up_proj OUTPUT ROWS and diag(t) into down_proj COLUMNS. Both tensors are already re-encoded from BF16 by the packer, so this needs NO new machinery, NO norm modification, NO runtime change and NO extra storage.
s_fold: diag(1/s) into the input_layernorm weight, which the packer COPIES rather than encodes. Implementing it means the pack path starts modifying copied tensors.
